name: Naia Slides
description: PDF·PPTX 불러오기·발표·PPTX 내보내기, 특정 페이지 시작, 집중·전체 화면, 발표자 메모 편집·접기, 나이아 창 MP4 녹화와 Workspace 재생을 지원하는 슬라이드 앱

descriptions.ko: PDF·PPTX 불러오기·발표와 PPTX 내보내기, 특정 페이지 시작, 집중·전체 화면, 발표자 메모 편집·접기, 나이아 창 MP4 녹화와 Workspace 재생을 지원합니다.
descriptions.en: Import and present PDF and PPTX decks in the browser or desktop shell, edit speaker notes and export to PPTX or Markdown, present in focus or full-screen mode, and record the Naia window to MP4.

tools.name: skill_slide_presenter
tools.description: Control the active Slides app (PDF & PPTX). Supports starting at a selected page, focus/full-screen presentation, editing speaker notes, exporting the presentation as a valid .pptx file (export_pptx), creating a new PPTX slide deck live (create_deck), and MP4 recording. Actions: start, pause, resume, stop, next, previous, goto, question, status, get_context, export_pptx, create_deck.

title.description: Presentation title when action is create_deck

slides.description: Slides array ({ title, subtitle?, bullets?, notes? }) when action is create_deck
